**Cuba: how applications changed.** The extract records 723,185 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 195,432 in 2022, compared with 138,066 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 197% higher than in 2019 (46,482). Applications in 2025 were 102% higher than in 2024 (68,383). In 2025, the leading destinations were Brazil (41,919; 30%), United States (40,348; 29%), Mexico (34,581; 25%). Brazil received 30% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 17% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 54%, across 12,302 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 82% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 1.8 percentage points higher than in 2024 (52%).
